name: Nikaidou Midori
source:
The protagonist's grandmother. The current head of the Nikaidou family and chairwoman of a trading company that deals in imported furniture. Although she knew where her daughter and son-in-law were living, she had opposed their relationship, making it difficult for her to face them. All she could do was watch over them from afar. She deeply regrets what happened with her daughter, and after her death, took her grandson in.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc092/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
